title: ReviewResult
description: What a review Job answers, as the last framed block of its log: one verdict per issue of the batch - can be closed (and why), a real bug, still to build - with the evidence for it, and how the read-only clones went. Hephaisto keeps the verdicts for a person to agree with or move; nothing here is applied by itself.

outcome.description: reviewed = the model answered and every issue of the batch has exactly one verdict (one it left out is unsure with low confidence). Any other outcome carries no verdicts.

verdicts.description: In the order of the request's issues, one each, and none for an issue that is not in the batch.

clones.description: Every repository an issue of the batch lives in: whether the Job had it to read, and why not.

head.description: The default branch's commit that was read.

note.description: Why it was not cloned: archived, not offered, could not be reached.

cost_usd.description: The SDK's total_cost_usd; notional on a subscription.

billing.description: Which credential paid: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN = subscription, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = api, the fake SDK = fake.

group.description: close = can be closed; bug = a problem that still exists; feature = a feature or task worth doing. unsure is never the model's: the runner gives it to an issue the model left out, or whose close came without a reason.

close_reason.description: Set exactly when group is close.

related.description: The pull request, issue or epic the verdict leans on most, when there is one.

confidence.description: low means a person decides: Hephaisto shows it as unsure, whatever the group.

summary.description: One line: what the issue is, as it stands now.

reason.description: Why this group, in plain text, naming the evidence.

evidence.description: Short facts, one each: `PR owner/repo#n merged`, `commit <sha> on main`, `sub-issue owner/repo#n closed`, `repository archived`, `no pull request`.

priority.description: The suggested board Priority, only for a bug or a feature: P0 drop everything, P1 important, P2 nice to have.
